scripts.test: node --test src/lib/*.test.mjs src/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs server/functions/tests/*.test.mjs server/functions/lib/*.test.mjs
scripts.emulate: npm run build && npm run pack:functions && npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:start --only hosting,functions,firestore
scripts.deploy: node build.mjs --live && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting,functions
scripts.deploy:hosting: node build.mjs --live && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.preview: node build.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d
